string.text: Hold this key while aiming your weapon to Focus in. Does not work on 2d overlay scopes.
If turned on, Focus will drain your stamina.
Higher values mean stamina drains faster when Focusing. Default is 0.75
Zoom multiplier when Focusing without a weapon.
Only applies if your weapon is holstered or unequipped. Higher values mean more zoom. Default is 0.9
Weapon distance when Focusing while aiming.
Lower values bring the weapon sights closer to you. Default is 1.35
Zoom multiplier when Focusing while aiming.
Works for most weapon sights. Does not work for 2D scopes. Higher values mean more zoom. Default is 0.65
